Hello fellow Panchira lovers,

Today I added character names in Gallery Mode.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34773827/636fc9f18bc6554f317ffc87700e97a4e41819d3.jpg

- 30 fps limits in "Low" and "Very low" graphic quality modes.

And I show you a trial 3D mode, that is now under construction.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34773827/e0368f334d6fabed04b51c2da07d6c462cc48fe1.png


See you next updateːsteamhappyː

notes.title: v1.02 Patch
notes.content:
The following features have been implemented:

- Fixed an issue that the numbers of times you cleared weren't saved.
- Fixed an issue that your best global scores weren't saved.
- Fixed an issue that you were had wait for 6000 sec before the connection error occured when you cleared the game.

notes.content: PanChira Concentration  receives a new adjustment patch that fixes the problem increasing other players' global scores too much.
